messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: building and pushing image registry.redwood.ai/inference/service:v3.2.1-rc2 (commit abcdef12)

deploy-bot: pushed to staging -> registry.redwood.ai/inference/service:v3.2.1-rc2
emma_release: staging push confirmed 👍

deploy-bot: starting push to prod-canary

deploy-bot: ERROR: signing-proxy returned 504 on layer sha256:9f8b2a; push aborted
priya_eng: looks like signing-proxy is flapping. Any fallback configured?

jason_sre: signing-proxy errors in us-west-2. We can skip signing for non-prod, but prod-canary requires signatures.
mark_qa: if we skip signing for canary we may violate attestation checks downstream.

emma_release: recommendation: abort canary, pin prod to prior image, and open incident for signing svc. We should not push unsigned to prod namespace.
oliver_prodops: +1. Action: pin prod to registry.redwood.ai/inference/service:v3.2.0 (commit 9a7c4d), stop canary, annotate release notes and schedule retry in change window.

priya_eng: I can spin up a quick RC that switches to backup-signing but that'll take ~45m. Pinning is fastest to unblock teams.

jason_sre: validating previous image...

deploy-bot: verification: registry.redwood.ai/inference/service:v3.2.0 -> exists, signature OK

oliver_prodops: running pin command

oliver_prodops:
```
redwoodctl pin-image --service=inference/service --env=prod --tag=v3.2.0 --reason="signing-proxy timeouts during v3.2.1-rc2 push"
```

oliver_prodops: pin applied (pin-id: pin-20260321-117)
emma_release: pausing prod canary rollout
emma_release: `kubectl rollout pause deployment/inference-service-canary -n prod`

mark_qa: forcing canary pods back to pinned image
mark_qa: `kubectl set image deployment/inference-service-canary inference=registry.redwood.ai/inference/service:v3.2.0 -n prod`

jason_sre: filing ticket for signing-proxy with SRE team and vendor; adding retries and exponential backoff to push flow.
priya_eng: updating CHANGES.md: v3.2.1-rc2 push failed due to external signing timeouts; prod pinned to v3.2.0; retry planned during maintenance window.

emma_release: maintenance window: 2026-03-21 03:00-04:00 UTC for reattempt once signing service is healthy.

deploy-bot: PUSH SUMMARY (thread 1785123456): staging: success (v3.2.1-rc2); prod-canary: failed (signing 504) -> prod pinned to v3.2.0; prod: unchanged

oliver_prodops: closing rollout for now. Will reopen when signing-proxy green.
priya_eng: I'll draft an emergency runbook for alternate signing endpoints and manual attestation steps.

deploy-bot: thread closed by oliver_prodops at 2026-03-21T05:20:00Z
